description:
intent=i041 snapshot=s12 branch=tasklet-napi-softirq-lock status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/ti/cpmac.c:425-437 confidence=high conclusion=cpmac_poll (NAPI/NET_RX softirq) and cpmac_hw_error workqueue worker share priv->rx_lock with plain spin_lock on both sides, so a same-CPU softirq can spin forever against the preempted worker (soft-lockup DoS).
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/natsemi/natsemi.c:2237 conclusion=Follow up: verify whether natsemi_change_mtu (process context, disable_irq but not BH) can still race natsemi_poll's plain np->lock acquisition after RxOn restarts interrupts, or whether napi_disable/stop-rings close the window.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/via/via-rhine.c:819 conclusion=Follow up: confirm whether napi_disable() ordering in rhine_close versus rhine_shutdown's plain rp->lock at 2315 leaves any window where the NAPI poll is still schedulable.
unresolved location=drivers/atm/solos-pci.c:455 conclusion=Follow up: trace console_show's procfs call chain and whether the solos_bh tasklet can still be scheduled while console_show holds cli_queue_lock, to confirm the softirq-vs-holder spin window.
unresolved location=drivers/tty/serial/atmel_serial.c:1364 conclusion=Follow up: check serial-core (tty/serial) paths that take atmel port->lock in process context with plain spin_lock to pair with atmel_tasklet_func at 1364.
coverage_gap=Lock correlation was done by textual lock-expression base name per file; locks reached through differently named pointer aliases, container_of indirection, or per-queue lock arrays between softirq and process sites could not be matched automatically.
coverage_gap=Only the tasklet callback body plus NAPI poll function and their same-file direct callees were treated as the softirq side; locks reached through deeper indirect calls (ops->, hw->, function-pointer tables, cross-file statics) were not resolved.
coverage_gap=NAPI poll registration was extracted positionally from netif_napi_add argument lists; nonstandard argument forms may have been missed, and NAPI polls in files that only call napi_schedule without netif_napi_add in the same file were not enumerated.
coverage_gap=Process-context sites that disable BH via local_bh_disable() nesting or spin_lock_bh on a different, outer lock were only manually resolved for the classified candidates; the full tree was not audited for that pattern.
artifact=findings/i041.json
